publish.description: Game Theme Music 3.7.0 adds Show mini player HUD (on/off, restart-persistent) without muting game, Store or Ambient music. Steam Deck hardware-tested.

description: Game Theme Music 3.7.0: Steam Deck soundtrack manager with optional persistent Show mini player HUD switch. Music continues when the HUD is hidden; includes Steam/non-Steam games, Ambient, Store and ResonaDeck audio focus.
